$comment: Hand-kept facts per family (title, summary, status, mainTag, `pages`:  sub-tags with a page of their own, token-table overrides) and per theme sheet (`themes`:  title), read by `yarn site:data`.  Shape:  `SitePagesFile` in src/docs-components/docs-components.types.ts.  Edit by hand;  a new family is added (seeded) by `yarn site:data`.

ui-brand-blob.title: Brand blob
ui-brand-blob.summary: A brand blob tucks one soft lavender shape into a corner of its parent, never behind body text.

ui-brand-checklist.title: Brand checklist
ui-brand-checklist.summary: A brand checklist shows a build's progress step by step, or a list of things to tick off, each with a round mark.

ui-brand-color.title: Brand color
ui-brand-color.summary: A brand color is a square colour chip:  a label inside, an AA mark, a selected ring, a details tip;  click to copy.

ui-brand-color-picker.title: Brand color picker
ui-brand-color-picker.summary: A brand color picker chooses a colour by lightness and colourfulness for a hue, or by typing its hex or OKLCH.

ui-brand-color-range.title: Brand color range
ui-brand-color-range.summary: A brand color range is a 17-step ladder of shades made from one base colour, the base colour's step ringed.

ui-brand-color-set.title: Brand color set
ui-brand-color-set.summary: A brand color set lays out colour chips in a row or a grid;  `selectable` makes it a radio group to pick one.

ui-brand-composer.title: Brand composer
ui-brand-composer.summary: A brand composer is the box where you describe an app in plain words and cast it:  a serif text box, tool chips, a keyboard hint and a round Cast button.

ui-brand-field.title: Brand field
ui-brand-field.summary: A brand field wraps one control with its label, a value readout, action buttons, an info tip, help and errors.

ui-brand-flourish.title: Brand flourish
ui-brand-flourish.summary: A brand flourish draws generated page art (swoops, blobs, curls, sparkles) behind its parent's content.

ui-brand-logo.title: Brand logo
ui-brand-logo.summary: The Spell logo:  the hat mark, or the mark with the wordmark (and tagline), outlined, in one colour.

ui-brand-phone.title: Brand phone
ui-brand-phone.summary: A brand phone frames live app content as a phone:  a status bar on top, the app below.
